entities.name: Diána Ürge-Vorsatz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diana Ürge-Vorsatz is a Hungarian scientist. She is a vice-chair of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, and professor of Environmental Sciences at Central European University. She was the Director of the Center for Climate Change and Sustainable Energy Policy. She has published widely on environmental and energy studies, primarily climate change mitigation.
